resolution.note: recordedShip honours a kept lane worktree whose tip is the shipped head; main() trims the branch; regression test red before, green after

title: Stop hook honours the ship record inside a kept lane worktree
body:
Seen 2026-11-17: lane t-nfztnf6 shipped PR #1341 (merged 16c85d2), its worktree kept on branch replay-arm-b (a lane agent's ship keeps it), and SubagentStop refused twice: "there is no commit on this branch yet" (src/hook/stop.ts inspectTests, ahead === 0 after the squash).
Cause: src/hook/stop.ts main() passes `git branch --show-current` stdout untrimmed, and recordedShip() returns false for any branch other than the base, so a ship record of the lane's own branch is never honoured while the lane worktree exists.
Outcome: a Stop inside a kept lane worktree whose tip equals the ship record's head and whose merge commit is on the base is allowed; the branch is trimmed.
Proof: a regression test calls recordedShip from a lane worktree on its branch with a matching record and gets true; with a different tip it gets false.
